desc: Cheerios Veggie Blends is an O-so-yummy cereal for the family made with fruits and vegetables. A wholesome serving of Veggie Blends Blueberry Banana, flavored with other natural flavors, contains 1/4 cup of fruit and veggies.* This sweetened oat and corn cereal is made with spinach, carrot, and sweet potato and is a delicious part of a breakfast or snack. Each serving is a good source of calcium, excellent source of iron, contains 12 vitamins and minerals, and has 15g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily). It's gluten free with no artificial flavors and no colors from artificial sources. Try Veggie Blends with milk as part of a tasty start to the day for kids and adults. Pack some as a crispy school snack. Sprinkle these little Os over yogurt for a between meal bite. Or take this Cheerios Cereal to go by adding it to snack mix recipes or homemade cereal bars. Whether you reach for a cereal box of Cheerios Veggie Blends as a flavorful addition to breakfast, snacks for kids, or ingredient in kids treats, General Mills cereals spread goodness from tots to grown-ups. *Made with fruit puree and vegetable powder. See full ingredients list. Not intended to replace fruit or vegetables in the diet.
features:
• MADE WITH FRUITS AND VEGGIES: Made with ¼ cup fruit and veggies* per serving; *Made with fruit puree and vegetable powder, see full ingredients list - not intended to replace fruit or vegetables in the diet; A delicious breakfast addition or snack
  • PACKED WITH GOODNESS: Every serving is a good source of calcium and excellent source of iron; Contains 12 vitamins and minerals, plus 15g whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily)
  • GLUTEN FREE: A gluten free cereal with no artificial flavors or colors from artificial sources
  • WHOLESOME SNACKS: Enjoy a bowl of cold cereal with milk, pack as crispy school snacks, or add to homemade snack mix or cereal bars; An ideal pantry staple
  • CONTAINS: One 10.6 oz cereal box of Cheerios Veggie Blends Blueberry Banana flavored with other natural flavors
ingredients:
Whole Grain Oats, Corn Meal, Sugar, Sweet Potato Powder, Corn Starch, Carrot Powder, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Salt, Banana Puree, Blueberry Puree Concentrate, Corn Syrup, Spinach Powder, Vegetable and Fruit Juice Color, Tripotassium Phosphate, Natural Flavor, Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.

Does not contain declaration obligatory allergens
